messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: Stripe outbound webhooks failing to deliver to /events/stripe (5xx/429 mix). Customer-facing payment flows degraded — some invoices stuck in 'processing'. Paging oncall-eric :rotating_light:

oncall-eric: on it. quick sanity — is this an app-side 500 or upstream? link to logs?

sre-ash: seeing a spike in 500s from the last deploy at 02:40Z. stacktrace looks like `KeyError: 'invoice_id'` in the webhook parser. sample log: `2026-03-15T02:51:23Z ERROR webhook-handler 500 KeyError invoice_id event=invoice.payment_succeeded id=evt_1JxxX`

support-ryan: customers reporting failed payments and "unable to complete purchase" in-app. ticket count ~8 so far, high-value customers included. Frontline is triaging.

eng-platform-lee: rollback or patch? can we gracefully handle missing fields and ack? If we return 200 quickly Stripe will stop retrying and resume.

sre-ash: agreed. quick hotfix in `webhook/parse.py` to default missing invoice_id -> null and ack event. deploying patch to canary now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: started deploy `hotfix/webhook-null-invoice` to canary (canary host x3)

eng-platform-lee: canary logs look good, no KeyError on same event ids. committing rollout to 30%

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout 30% complete -> success

oncall-eric: recheck Stripe delivery status. did Stripe start throttling/delaying deliveries?

stripe-status-bot: from Stripe status page: "We are seeing delays in outbound webhook delivery for some customers due to retry throttling. Issue started 2026-03-15T02:45Z. Investigating." https://status.stripe.com/incident/abc123

billing-maya: note — Stripe sent a message about quota enforcement for our account (rate-limited webhooks) because of repeated 500s. They say resends may be delayed by up to 30m. We have to treat as partial outage for payments.

support-ryan: communicating to customers: posting incident note in status page and templating responses for support. request from billing: list of customers with pending invoice events (IDs).

sre-ash: we can generate list from event log `select * from stripe_events where processed=false and attempt_count>0` — will paste CSV to ops channel in 10m.

eng-platform-lee: as a mitigation, we can send a proactive reconciliation job to fetch missed events using Stripe's Events API for the affected time window. curl example:```
curl -s -u sk_live_xxx: "https://api.stripe.com/v1/events?created[gte]=1615800000&limit=100"
```

oncall-eric: do that — but careful with rate limits. throttle to 10 reqs/sec and exponential backoff on 429. coordinate with billing to prioritize invoices for customers currently blocked.

billing-maya: starting prioritized fetch for top 20 accounts. will reconcile and trigger manual grant if invoice.payment_succeeded exists.

incident-bot: incident severity elevated to P1 due to customer-impacting billing delays. Paging rotation called for SRE + Billing ops.

support-ryan: posted to status: "Degraded: Stripe webhook deliveries are delayed. Some payments and subscription activations may be delayed up to 30 minutes while retries/resends occur. Our engineers are reconciling missed events." link /status

eng-platform-lee: followup: pushed reconciliation worker with conservative rate limiting, starting at 5 reqs/sec. logs show fetch success for several missed events; triggering internal processing now.

sre-ash: processing pipeline is idempotent, safe to reprocess. marking events processed after success. sample internal log: `processed event evt_1JxxX invoice  inv_9aZ -> grant access user=u_123`

billing-maya: manual grants done for 6 high-value accounts. ticket updates sent.

oncall-eric: handoff note — I'm heading out at 03:15Z. leaving watch with @sre-ash. things to monitor: (1) Stripe status page updates, (2) backlog size in `stripe_events` pending>0, (3) customer-facing tickets for payment failures. If Stripe extends throttling beyond 30m escalate to Stripe support with ticket ref `INC-8129`.

sre-ash: ack, taking over. will keep polling Stripe status and our backlog. setting alert: backlog_count > 50 -> page oncall.

support-ryan: updating customers who asked for ETA. added note: "We're processing missed webhook events and reconciling payments. If your payment failed, it may be processed shortly; contact support if urgent." :email:

stripe-status-bot: status update: "Deliveries recovering, delays decreasing. We are continuing to monitor." 03:05Z

eng-platform-lee: monitoring graphs show webhook 5xx rate went from 12% -> 0.8% after hotfix and reconciliation. delivery retries still trickling in but being consumed.

billing-maya: Stripe replied to our support ticket: they will remove transient rate-limits once delivery success rate is stable. provided ticket link: https://support.stripe.com/ticket/987654

incident-bot: incident resolved -> reduced to P2. pending followups: postmortem, add schema validation on webhook ingestion, and add canned fallback to ack+enqueue if missing fields.

oncall-eric: leaving final note: root cause was a schema change in our code -> missing `invoice_id` in parser after last deploy. mitigation: hotfix to default missing fields and proactive reconciliation via Events API while Stripe drained backlog.

sre-ash: will own postmortem and remediation. tagging eng-platform and billing.

support-ryan: closing related customer tickets where resolved, leaving ones still open for manual follow-up.

billing-maya: will follow up with Stripe for any billing discrepancies due to the delivery delays.

incident-bot: incident thread closed at 03:28Z — notes saved to incidents/1809123456-stripe-invoice-ack-failures-oncall-handoff\"
